binding: exact prompt and schema hashes via T14

stages.name: concepts
stages.check: strict JSON, known prerequisite ids, one Luna retry

stages.name: graph-sanity
stages.check: suspected orphan procedures >20 percent or repaired cycles, <=one per chapter

stages.name: wording
stages.check: batch per chapter, budgets, exactly one MCQ answer

stages.name: formula-perturb
stages.check: source identity RHS +1/-1 distractors; false claim RHS+1

stages.name: worked-example
stages.check: procedure lacking numbered source example, <=one per concept

stages.name: fade-order
stages.check: last step/last half blank, original answers retained

stages.name: spot-sanity
stages.check: script injects one sign error, model checks plausible and unique; rejects omitted with reason

stages.name: answer-check
stages.check: batched independent solve; authored answers withheld

stages.name: answer-symbolic
stages.check: SymPy perturbation proof first when installed; independently re-solve via Luna next

stages.name: answer-compare
stages.check: normalized exact comparison, restricted SymPy arithmetic when present

stages.name: answer-equivalence
stages.check: batched semantic comparison after independent solve

stages.name: answer-dispute
stages.check: only substantive disagreement, <=one per card; unresolved flagged

frontier: Definitions are precompiled Python procedures, not evidence-derived T5 manual.compile artifacts.
